This '''pin-up of a Twi'lek''' was a decorative poster available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It showed a scantily clad [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]<ref name="Rookies" /> [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/lethal-trackdown-trivia-gallery|text="Lethal Trackdown" Trivia Gallery|quote=The nightclub on Coruscant is filled with posters of various female pin-up models}} {{C|Slide 6}}</ref> in a seductive pose.<ref name="Rookies" />

==Behind the scenes==
This image was painted by [[Justin Ridge]],<ref name="The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''</ref> and was developed for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode [[Rookies (episode)|''Rookies'']]. In the episode, it can be seen gracing the walls in [[Rishi Station/Legends|Rishi Station]].<ref name="Rookies" /> The poster can also be seen in [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's]] [[Hondo's complex/Legends|pirate outpost]] in ''[[The Gungan General]]''<ref name="The Gungan General">{{TCW|The Gungan General}}</ref> and ''[[Lethal Trackdown]]'',<ref name="Lethal">{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> in the [[Christophsis Republic base/Legends|Christophsis Republic base]] in ''[[The Hidden Enemy]]'', in [[Cliffhold/Legends|Cliffhold]] in ''[[Mystery of a Thousand Moons]]'',<ref name="Mystery of a Thousand Moons">{{TCW|Mystery of a Thousand Moons}}</ref> and the [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]] in ''Lethal Trackdown''.<ref name="Lethal" />
